title: Delegation with Technology Migration: An Empirical Analysis of Mobile Virtual Network Operators
eligible_reason: Matching-based stacked design. Host MNOs that launch a discount MVNO are matched to control MNOs by dynamic propensity-score matching (psmatch2, nearest neighbour, caliper 0.05), run separately for each launch quarter; the matched sets are appended into one file (combinedb, combinedt). after = 1 after the matched launch quarter enters as its own regressor, time FE are year and quarter-of-year, and every column includes time-varying controls (ARPU, market size, GDP per capita, launch gap, TV, HHI) (Tables 1-2). GSMA Intelligence data are proprietary; only an illustrative 36-row excerpt is shipped.
design_notes: Data Transformation.do lines ~145-168 (psmatch2 loop by matching period, after indicator, append); Table 1.do: areg mktshare_2g/3g after c.treat_b#c.after $control i.year i.quarter, a(id) r.
n_eligible_specs_note: Stacked matched design with time-varying controls and an event-time main effect.
data_files_note: README: the Sample sheet only illustrates the structure of the final dataset.
